designationHistory.indexText: Harris Neck National Wildlife Refuge was established in 1962 and has since served as a premier nesting, foraging, and wintering habitat for many species of wildlife.
designationHistory.note: The refuge page gives only the month or year. The refuge page does not say how it was established.
